legend: You are given two numbers $A$ and $B$. Print "Multiples" if one of them is a multiple of the other (that is, $A$ divides $B$ or $B$ divides $A$), and "No Multiples" otherwise.
input: One line with two integers $A$ and $B$ ($1 \le A, B \le 10^6$).
notes: 9 is divisible by 3, so the first answer is "Multiples". 24 is divisible by 6, so the second is "Multiples" too. Neither of 12 and 5 divides the other.
